An '''unidentified Sith Lord''' of the first [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] was [[Burial/Legends|buried]] in the [[Tomb of Naga Sadow|tomb]] of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] known as [[Darth Baras]] sent his [[Empire's Wrath|new apprentice]] to the tomb in order to retrieve an ancient [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The apprentice eventually discovered a reliquary that contained the remains of this unidentified Sith [[Clothing/Legends|clad]] in an [[Ancient Sith armor|ancient form]] of [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="LoDG" /> After claiming the lightsaber ancient guardians awakened to attack the apprentice but were swiftly defeated.

==Behind the scenes==
As revealed in [[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]], the Sith Lord Naga Sadow died in exile on the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]],<ref name="FOTSE5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]]</ref> where his body was [[Naga Sadow's tomb|buried]].<ref name="TL">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?|int=Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?}}</ref> Whoever he or she was, the Sith buried in the Korriban tomb could not be Sadow himself.
